title: Staff travel (v1)
description: Church-related driving by staff in an electric vehicle, by vehicle slug and billing month. Scope 3, never added to the campus totals. Unknown extra fields are allowed.

emissions_unit.description: tCO2e: metric tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent.

avoided_note.description: How to read avoided_tco2e: compared with a gasoline car, not subtracted from campus totals.

rows.description: One row per vehicle per billing month, ordered by vehicle id then month. Empty when there is no travel data.

vehicle_id.description: A made-up slug; the vehicle model is not published.

tco2e_counted_here.description: Emissions counted in this block, or null when the vehicle charges at the church and they are already counted in campus electricity.

avoided_tco2e.description: Avoided emissions compared with a gasoline car. Informational.

data_quality.description: estimate or odometer. New values may be added.

estimated.description: True unless the miles come from an odometer reading.
